score_rationale: The candidate shows strong programming and mentoring skills relevant to the coding enrichment portion, but lacks essential hands‑on IT support experience and any background working with children or safeguarding, which are core to 70% of the role.
key_strengths: Strong Python proficiency; proven ability to troubleshoot complex systems and mentor/explain technical concepts to others.
key_weaknesses: No demonstrable first‑line IT support, hardware/printer/AV experience; lacking familiarity with Intune, Active Directory, Google Classroom, or school‑based device management; no evidence of working with young people, safeguarding awareness, or extracurricular coding clubs; located abroad requiring visa/relocation.
final_evaluation: While the candidate could contribute to the coding side of the role, the substantial gaps in practical school IT support and youth‑focused experience make them a poor fit for this hybrid position; they would need considerable upskilling and relocation, which is unlikely given the seniority and salary band.
